column18: Hybrid DNN-neuromorphic structure claims dramatic power reduction versus traditional AI models at competitive accuracy; no figures in abstract.
Gradual iterative magnitude pruning with knowledge distillation finds graph lottery tickets; outperforms UGS; no efficiency figures.
ANN-to-SNN knowledge distillation: ResNet-18 CIFAR-100 80.48% with four timesteps vs ANN 79.90%; no other efficiency metric.
KS-Lottery finds small parameter subsets (18 token embeddings of LLaMA suffice) matching full fine-tuning for translation; certified in embedding layer.
Sparse spike encoding with SNN classifies MNIST/Fashion-MNIST; fewer input pixels and spikes than traditional methods; no ANN energy comparison.
Layer-wise ANN-to-SNN distillation: competitive accuracy with ANNs and faster inference than converted SNNs; no ANN efficiency comparison.
Prunable network yields compatible subnetworks at any capacity via post-training pruning for asymmetric retrieval; no efficiency figures.
Meta-LTH prunes meta-learner by magnitude pruning; about 2% accuracy gain over first-order MAML (20-way 1-shot, Omniglot, FC100).
PIM processor for DNN/SNN training and inference, 179.8 TFLOPS/W in title; abstract lists challenges only, no ANN-SNN comparison.
Pipeline uses over 10,000x less energy than current frame-based methods at similar performance on real event camera datasets.
SSA operator raises structured sparsity 1.8x with under 1% accuracy loss; sparsity-aware dataflow gives 16% throughput, 18% energy gains.
Overview of neuromorphic computing for data analytics; asserts energy and latency advantages over CNNs and transformers, no quantitative results.
Training-free pruning-based NAS for SNNs with sparsity-aware fitness; 98x search speedup over SNASNet, +4.49% on DVS128-Gesture.
Low-rank tensor decomposition compresses spiking transformer: 84.49% parameter compression on ImageNet, memory 42.29% of original; no pruning, no ANN comparison.
Inference time 2.8-28.4% and energy 13.3-14.4% of SOTA methods; accuracy +4-6.8% for EV battery fault diagnosis.
Lightweight SNNs deployed on ARM Cortex-M4 for EMG gestures, accuracy 78.89% and 70.83%; suitability over ANNs asserted, no efficiency comparison.
LTH-inspired filter pruning of U-Net: parameters reduced from 31 M to 1.9 M with improved segmentation accuracy.
Hybrid ANN-SNN classifier of 18 Eimeria species from microscope images; significant energy savings from SNN layers claimed, no figures.
ANN-to-SNN conversion reaching 98.73% MNIST with one time step and 93.71% CIFAR-10 with eight; only time steps reported as efficiency.
Hoyer-regularized one-step SNNs: extremely sparse activations, up to 34x compute-efficiency gain; in-sensor front-end cuts energy 2.3x and bandwidth 96x.
Binarized spiking Transformer for EEG attention detection; model size 21x below full-precision counterpart; power claimed without comparison.
SNN-based seizure detection processor on Xilinx ZCU102 FPGA: 98.1% accuracy, 3.73 µJ per classification; no ANN comparison stated.
FPGA conversion: CIFAR-10 accuracy 88.01% and 91.96% vs ANN 88.95% and 92.43%; up to 3x lower power than ANN.
Random and Gaussian spike masking cut spiking Transformer energy; RSM with 70% masking gives best DVS128 accuracy; no figures.
Dynamic joint spike and weight pruning achieves up to 126.38x SOP compression ratio on CIFAR-10 with minimal accuracy loss.
